questions.question: Which one of the following statements is** **INCORRECT?

options.text: The measurable unit of pressure is denoted in Metre.
Matter is made up of small particles.
Brass is a mixture of 30% zinc and 70% copper.

questions.solution:
Option **1** is correct, i.e.** __The measurable unit of pressure is denoted in Metre__**.

__
 
• **Pressure:**

 
 
• The measurable **unit of pressure** is denoted in **Pascal** and **not in Metre**__. 
 
• One Pascal is equal to one **Newton per square meter**.
 
• The pressure is nothing but the force per unit area applied in the direction perpendicular to the surface.
 
 

**Extra facts:**

 
• **The matter** is made up of **small particles** called **atoms,** which are further made up of electrons, protons, and neutrons.
 
• **Brass** is an alloy of **30% zinc** and **70% copper**. It is resistant to corrosion.
 
• **Evaporation** causes cooling- When the liquid is converted into gas, the molecules absorb the energy, giving a cooling effect.
